name: Mojibake
source: Homicipher is an adventure horror game where you’ll decipher a language, fall in love and escape. Players will face various horrifying men in this strange world. Your aim is to decipher their language and eventually find a way to escape. Meanwhile, a peculiar feeling also starts to bloom.
translation: Homicipher是一款冒险恐怖游戏，你将在其中破译一种语言、坠入爱河并逃脱。玩家将在这个陌生的世界中面对各种恐怖的男人。你的目标是破译他们的语言并最终找到逃跑的方法。与此同时，一种奇异的感觉也开始绽放。
